summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a $2.0 million milestone payment from Exelixis under their existing collaboration and license agreement, triggered by a preclinical milestone for XB404, a SAFEbody masked antibody-drug conjugate targeting ROR1/2-expressing tumors. A separate payment followed selection of candidates for another SAFEbody ADC program. Adagene retains eligibility for additional development and commercialization milestones plus royalties on net sales. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is an ordinary collaboration progress update, not a special situation; watch for subsequent milestone disclosures and pipeline advancement as the value driver.
